title: Freezing Chaos - Stats, Combo & How to Get
description: Freezing Chaos in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

facts.label: How to obtain
facts.value: Crimson Forest, Threadbound Great Tree (one checklist attributes it to Yucong, No. 34)

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Freezing Chaos is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. One checklist attributes it to Yucong, No. 34, rather than to the tree itself; both routes are recorded because sources disagree.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Freezing Chaos occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Freezing Chaos has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Nothing verified has been published on how Freezing Chaos behaves inside a combo, so no chain is described here. The general rule still applies: swapping to a secondary refills stamina instead of spending it, so the second slot is what extends a chain past the point the blade you were using runs dry - see the combat system.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Crimson Forest, Threadbound Great Tree (one checklist attributes it to Yucong, No. 34).

Dropped by Yucong, the Twisted Puppet - see that page for the fight itself, and boss drops for the reverse list.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page records Freezing Chaos by slot, class and acquisition point, and by its property where one is published. Figures the game itself does not expose are left out. The system as a whole, with the full slot and class breakdown, is on the weapons list.
